Wedding Warmup
Allegra & Aaron · Costa Rica · January 3–7, 2027

Dear Family & Friends,

We are so grateful to spend a few days together, off the beaten path, before our big day. Call it a joint bachelor party, a friendsmoon, or a wedding warmup, from lake hiking to rainforest glamping, this will be a trip we remember for the rest of our lives.

Here's everything you need to know; we can't wait to hear from you soon.

With love,
Ally & Aaron

Photo of Allegra & Aaron
01 — The Journey

We'll experience two completely different sides of Costa Rica over four nights — first the adventure-and-volcano energy of Arenal, then the wild, glamping-in-the-rainforest calm of Río Celeste — before the group travels on to the wedding at El Mangroove.

Jan 3–5 · @ Arenal Heights
Adventures near Arenal Volcano, in La Fortuna
Sunday, Jan 3: Fly into LIR before 12:00 pm
Jan 5–7 · @ Río Celeste
Glamping and Relaxation before the big day
Thursday, Jan 7: Group bus to the wedding

Arenal Heights Villas

View on Google Maps
A private cluster of modern villas at the foot of the volcano.

Each villa

Together
Villas side by side on one private property — the group has the run of it
Town

Shared

03 — Where We Stay · Nights 3–4
RÍO CELESTE · TENORIO VOLCANO
Auralta Río Celeste
Jan 5 – 7 · Nights 3–4
A brand new luxury tented camp on a private rainforest reserve, beside the famous turquoise river.
The vibe
Glamping done at a five-star level — wild, serene, completely immersed in nature
The setting
14-hectare native forest, 700m of private Río Celeste riverfront, volcano views
On site
Restaurant, bar, infinity pool, spa & massage
Dining
Very remote, so all meals at the hotel restaurant
Nearby
10 min to the Río Celeste waterfall & Tenorio National Park

05 — Choose Your Accommodations

Here's the part we need from you. The two packages are identical in every way — same activities, meals, transport, group, and villa stay in Arenal. The only real difference is your tent at Auralta: a shared Deluxe tent or your own private Suite. Tents are limited, so the sooner you choose, the better.

Open to sharing
Package A — Shared
A bed in a shared villa room in Arenal, and a shared Deluxe tent (twin beds available) at Auralta. Perfect if you're traveling solo or happy to bunk with a friend.
$1,500 per person · all in
✓ 11 tents available
Your own space
Package B — Private
A private room for you (and your plus-one) in the Arenal villa, and a private Suite tent at Auralta — king bed and your own outdoor jacuzzi. Ideal for couples.
$2,000 per person · all in
✓ 7 tents available
Prices are per person for all four nights and include everything in "What's Included" above. Approximate and subject to final confirmation on booking.

Evening

Morning · main

Morning
